environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. AWS WAF v2 WebACL is associated with the ALB. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to COUNT (permissive), and CrossSiteScripting_QUERYSTRING set to COUNT. (2) Priority 200: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' with NO action overrides — all rules in BLOCK mode including SQLi_QUERYSTRING, SQLi_BODY, SQLi_COOKIE, and SQLi_URIPATH. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the SQLi rule group is actively evaluating and blocking requests. Additionally, the WAF is configured with a custom response body (403 JSON: {"error":"request_denied"}) for blocked requests.

config.load_balancer: ALB with AWS WAF v2 WebACL association

rules.name: SQLiProtection
rules.note: All rules active in default BLOCK mode
